{"hypotheses": [
{"name": "Composite 1", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high book-to-market ratios and low accruals should outperform due to their undervaluation and potential for mean reversion.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "BM"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "Accruals"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},
{"name": "Composite 2", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high intangible assets and low R&D expenses should have higher returns due to their ability to generate profits from existing assets.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "IntanBM"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "RD"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.7, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 24},
{"name": "Composite 3", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high net operating assets and low operating leverage should outperform due to their ability to manage working capital efficiently.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "NOA"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "OPLeverage"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "large", "direction": "weaker"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.9, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 48},
{"name": "Composite 4", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high gross profits and low intangible assets should have higher returns due to their ability to generate cash flows from tangible assets.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GP"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "IntanBM"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_UP", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.6, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 18},
{"name": "Composite 5", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high dividend yields and low volatility should outperform due to their attractive valuation and low risk.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "DivYieldST"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "RealizedVol"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "micro", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.85, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 42},
{"name": "Composite 6", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high return on equity and low debt issuance should have higher returns due to their ability to generate profits from existing assets and manage debt efficiently.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "RoE"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "DebtIssuance"}], "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_POSITIVE", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "TERM_SPREAD_NEGATIVE", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom12m", "bound": "below", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "international", "region": "developed_ex_us", "direction": "same_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.75, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 30},
{"name": "Composite 7", 
"mechanism": "Firms with high cash flows and low capital expenditures should outperform due to their ability to generate cash flows from existing assets.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "CF"}, {"weight": -1.0, "primitive": "grcapx"}], "regime": null, "vol_target": true}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "MKT_TRAILING_12M_DOWN", "direction": "higher"}, {"type": "size_segment", "segment": "small", "direction": "stronger"}, {"type": "subperiod_consistency"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.8, 
"expected_decay_half_life_months": 36},
{"name": "Composite 8", 
"mechanism": "Companies with high sales growth and low inventory growth should have higher returns due to their ability to manage working capital efficiently.", 
"expression": {"terms": [{"weight": 1.0, "primitive": "GrSaleToGrInv"}, {"weight": -0.5, "primitive": "InvGrowth"}], "regime": "VIX_BELOW_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "vol_target": false}, 
"auxiliary_predictions": [{"type": "regime_interaction", "regime": "VIX_ABOVE_TRAILING_MEDIAN", "direction": "lower"}, {"type": "correlation", "primitive": "Mom6m", "bound": "above", "threshold": 0.3}, {"type": "international", "region": "emerging", "direction": "opposite_sign"}], 
"expected_annualized_sharpe": 0.65,

]}
